oracleAuthorship: New source-first wording authored from original Ultima V/VI declarations and existing manifest witness/provenance. Existing independent-corpus schema examples were consulted for format only. No new semantic-field runtime outputs, planner outcomes, browser outcomes or model outputs were inspected or executed while authoring this corpus.
validationScope: 32 turns in eight four-turn dialogues: four dialogues per game, each with three source-answerable positives and one unsupported boundary (24 positives, eight negatives). Exact child source locators and complete useful claims are fixed before execution. Each positive needs one source witness; no allSources/allFactIds is imposed when one witness suffices. Unknown player state and unsupported quantities/materials/substitutions remain boundaries.

turns.text: Why should I clear out the Shadowlords before collecting the Sceptre?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Banish the Shadowlords before retrieval so they cannot reclaim the Sceptre later; do not assert that the player has already done so.
expected.sourceWitness: Banish the Shadowlords first so they cannot reclaim the Sceptre later.

turns.text: At Stonegate, what opens the central door, and what answer gets me past the demon?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Use a Skull Key for the center door and answer the demon’s riddle with WELL. The Grapple is the recorded approach tool.
expected.sourceWitness: Reach Stonegate with the Grapple, unlock the center door with a Skull Key, and answer the demon’s riddle with WELL.

turns.text: Beyond that door, how should I cross the pits and trapdoors to pick it up?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Ride the Magic Carpet over the fire pits and trapdoors, take the Sceptre, and leave before the tower becomes crowded.
expected.sourceWitness: Ride the Magic Carpet over the fire pits and trapdoors, take the Sceptre, and leave before the tower becomes crowded.

turns.text: Which metal is the Sceptre made from?

expected.boundary: The cited retrieval instructions and approved source facts do not identify the Sceptre’s construction material. A function, route or pickup instruction cannot establish a metal.

turns.text: For the Faulinei expedition, who teaches the dungeon word after Malik points me onward, and what is the word?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Malik leads to Malifora, from whom the player learns FALLAX. Do not swap the teacher and the intermediary.
expected.sourceWitness: Learn FALLAX from Malifora after Malik points you to her.

turns.text: I mean summoning him at the Lycaeum next: where do I stand, and what do I shout?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: At the Lycaeum stand one tile south of the Flame of Truth and shout FAULINEI.
expected.sourceWitness: At the Lycaeum, stand one tile south of the Flame of Truth and shout FAULINEI.

turns.text: After shouting his name, when should I use the Shard of Falsehood?

contains: when Faulinei stands on the flame
expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Wait one turn and use the Shard of Falsehood when Faulinei stands on the flame; merely having the Shard is not the timed use instruction.
expected.sourceWitness: Wait one turn, then use the Shard of Falsehood when Faulinei stands on the flame.

turns.text: How many real-world seconds does that one-turn wait last?

expected.boundary: The source specifies one game turn but gives no real-world duration or conversion to seconds. No exact duration may be invented.

turns.text: Which companions should I keep at the beginning, and who needs healing before roadside combat?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Keep Iolo and Shamino while the party is small and heal Shamino before road fights.
expected.sourceWitness: Keep Iolo and Shamino while the party is small; heal Shamino before taking road fights.

turns.text: I want Julia as the next replacement. Where do I recruit her?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Recruit Julia upstairs at Empath Abbey; retain Julia as the explicit new recruitment subject.
expected.sourceWitness: Follow the road to Empath Abbey and recruit Julia upstairs. She is the strongest practical early replacement when the party begins to fill.

turns.text: For the planned full roster, give me the six names and the later mage replacement for Julia.

contains: Avatar, Iolo, Jaana, Julia, Gwenno, and Mariah
expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Give the recommended six-person roster and identify Johne as the later replacement for Julia. The source’s optional Shamino-at-an-inn instruction may also be quoted.
expected.sourceWitness: Aim for Avatar, Iolo, Jaana, Julia, Gwenno, and Mariah. If you need space, leave Shamino at an inn; later, Johne can replace Julia for an even more magic-heavy endgame party.

turns.text: Which member of that recommended six has the highest Luck score?

expected.boundary: The approved party and companion sources provide no Luck statistic. The roster and other recorded attributes cannot establish a Luck ranking.

turns.text: Who supplies the Honor mantra, and what condition should I meet before asking?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Ask Gruman when karma is high enough; the Honor mantra is SUMM. Do not invent a numeric karma threshold.
expected.sourceWitness: Ask Gruman when your karma is high enough. Record the mantra SUMM.

turns.text: For that shrine’s meditation, which word do I use and how long should I meditate?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: At the Shrine of Honor speak the virtue name and meditate using SUMM for three cycles.
expected.sourceWitness: Visit the Shrine of Honor, speak the virtue name, and meditate with SUMM for three cycles.

turns.text: Correction—I am asking about Humility’s completion bonus now: what attributes does that shrine add?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: The Shrine of Humility grants no attribute bonus on completion; do not carry Honor’s attribute outcome into the corrected Humility subject.
expected.sourceWitness: Return to the Shrine of Humility and meditate again to complete the quest; this shrine grants no attribute bonus.

turns.text: Is the floor of the Humility shrine granite or basalt?

expected.boundary: The guide does not identify the shrine floor’s stone type. Neither the shrine’s name nor its lack of an attribute bonus supplies a construction material.

turns.text: I need panpipes for the Sacrifice task. Who supplies the wood, how is it prepared, and who makes the instrument?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Buy a yew log from Ben west of Yew, cut it into a board and ask Julia to craft PANPIPES; keep supplier, preparation and maker roles distinct.
expected.sourceWitness: Buy a yew log from Ben west of Yew, cut it into a board, and ask Julia to craft `PANPIPES`.

turns.text: And who teaches the tune, what song topic should I use, and what is its number sequence?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Ask Gwenno about STONES to learn the numeric tune 6789878767653.
expected.sourceWitness: Ask Gwenno about the song `STONES` to learn the numeric tune 6789878767653.

turns.text: Who do I perform it for, and where, to earn the rune?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Perform the established tune for Selganor inside the Artisan Guild to receive the rune. Gwenno is the tune teacher, not the performance recipient.
expected.sourceWitness: Perform the tune for Selganor inside the Artisan Guild to receive the rune.

turns.text: What tempo in beats per minute does that tune require?

expected.boundary: The source gives a numeric tune sequence, not a musical tempo. It does not establish any beats-per-minute value.

turns.text: Where should I look for the balloon plans, including the coordinates?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Recover the balloon plans from Sutek’s catacombs at 65S 52E.
expected.sourceWitness: Recover the balloon plans from Sutek's catacombs at 65S 52E.

turns.text: For the balloon cloth, how much spidersilk is needed, and who turns it into thread and cloth?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Gather 40 spidersilk; Arbeth in Paws spins the thread, then Charlotte in New Magincia weaves the cloth. Do not swap the two workers or cities.
expected.sourceWitness: Gather 40 spidersilk, have Arbeth in Paws spin thread, and Charlotte in New Magincia weave cloth.

turns.text: Once every component is in my inventory, what do I do with the plans, and what burner items must I collect?

contains: USE the plans once all parts are in your inventory
expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Collect rope and a large pot for the burner, then USE the plans once all parts are in inventory. Treat the question’s inventory condition hypothetically, without claiming to observe it.
expected.sourceWitness: Collect rope and a large pot for the burner, then `USE` the plans once all parts are in your inventory.

turns.text: Can I replace those 40 spidersilk with hemp and keep the same recipe?

expected.boundary: The approved recipe specifies spidersilk and provides no hemp substitution or equivalence rule. A supported recipe cannot establish an alternate ingredient.

turns.text: Where do I meet Ybarra for his map piece, and what does he accept in exchange?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Find Ybarra in Dungeon Shame and trade food for his map piece.
expected.sourceWitness: Trade food to Ybarra in Dungeon Shame for his map piece.

turns.text: Actually, the next trade I meant is Morchella’s. Where is she, and what should I bring for her shard?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Morchella is east of Serpent’s Hold and trades her shard for a MAGIC SHIELD. Do not carry over Ybarra’s food requirement.
expected.sourceWitness: Trade Morchella east of Serpent's Hold a `MAGIC SHIELD` for her shard.

turns.text: With Bonn, am I trading something or moving an object? Where does his fragment hide?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Move Bonn’s harpsichord on Dagger Isle to expose the cellar ladder and fragment; this is an object-moving instruction rather than one of the preceding trades.
expected.sourceWitness: Move Bonn's harpsichord on Dagger Isle to reveal a cellar ladder and fragment.

turns.text: What is the weight in kilograms of Bonn’s harpsichord?

expected.boundary: The source identifies the object and moving it but gives no weight or unit conversion. No kilogram figure can be inferred from its being movable.

turns.text: For the broken red gargoyle lens, where is it recovered and who handles the repair?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Retrieve the broken red lens from the Hall of Knowledge and deliver it to Lor-wis-lem the lens grinder.
expected.sourceWitness: Retrieve the broken red lens from the Hall of Knowledge and deliver it to Lor-wis-lem the lens grinder.

turns.text: Switch to the blue human lens: who makes that one, what do I bring, and which topics do I mention?

expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Take a glass sword to Ephemerides in Moonglow, discuss LENS and SWORD, and receive the blue Britannian lens. Keep its maker and input distinct from the red lens repair.
expected.sourceWitness: Take a glass sword to Ephemerides in Moonglow, discuss `LENS` and `SWORD`, and receive the blue Britannian lens.

turns.text: At the Codex, which side gets the Britannian lens and which gets the gargoyle lens?

contains: Britannian lens between the left flame and the Codex
gargoyle lens between the right flame and the Codex
expected.requiredUsefulClaim: Place the Britannian lens between the left flame and the Codex and the gargoyle lens between the right flame and the Codex; both directed placements are required.
expected.sourceWitness: Set the Britannian lens between the left flame and the Codex, and the gargoyle lens between the right flame and the Codex.

turns.text: What exact angle in degrees should I set each of those lenses to?

expected.boundary: The source specifies relative placement between flames and the Codex, but no angular settings in degrees. Directional placement does not establish an exact angle.
